text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan (Barang-Barang

Kawalan) 2017.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai barang-barang

kawalan bagi tempoh dari 23 Januari 2017 hingga 3 Februari 2017.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

2. Ikan bawal putih (berat antara 200 gram hingga 400 gram seekor)

3. Udang putih besar (berat antara 41 ekor hingga 60 ekor sekilogram)

4. Babi hidup

5. Daging babi (perut)

6. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 20 Januari 2017

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/X]

DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

Order 2017.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for the

period from 23 January 2017 to 3 February 2017.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

2. White pomfret (weight ranges between 200 grams to 400 grams each)

3. Large banana prawn (weight ranges between 41 prawns to 60 prawns

per kilogram)

4. Live pig

5. Pork (belly)

6. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 20 January 2017

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/X]

DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN

Minister of Domestic Trade,

Co-operatives and Consumerism
